mapper.sql: connection_id, provider_id, external_order_id, external_user_id, external_drama_id, search_code, channel_code, partner_id, order_amount_minor, order_amount, currency, raw_status, status, paid_at, provider_updated_at, custom_params, raw_payload_json, sync_start_date, sync_end_date, last_synced_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotion_order WHERE connection_id=#{connectionId} AND external_order_id=#{externalOrderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_order (, tracking_no, promotion_link_id, user_id, drama_id, attribution_status, rule_history_id, channel_fee_rate, principal_fee_rate, principal_commission_rate, downstream_fee_rate, downstream_commission_rate, commission_amount, commission_status, last_error_message) VALUES (#{connectionId}, #{providerId}, #{externalOrderId}, #{externalUserId}, #{externalDramaId}, #{searchCode}, #{channelCode}, #{partnerId}, #{orderAmountMinor}, #{orderAmount}, #{currency}, #{rawStatus}, #{status}, #{paidAt}, #{providerUpdatedAt}, #{customParams}, #{rawPayloadJson}, #{syncStartDate}, #{syncEndDate}, #{lastSyncedAt}, #{trackingNo}, #{promotionLinkId}, #{userId}, #{dramaId}, #{attributionStatus}, #{ruleHistoryId}, #{channelFeeRate}, #{principalFeeRate}, #{principalCommissionRate}, #{downstreamFeeRate}, #{downstreamCommissionRate}, #{commissionAmount}, #{commissionStatus}, #{lastErrorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE promotion_order SET external_user_id=#{externalUserId}, external_drama_id=#{externalDramaId}, search_code=#{searchCode}, channel_code=#{channelCode}, partner_id=#{partnerId}, order_amount_minor=#{orderAmountMinor}, order_amount=#{orderAmount}, currency=#{currency}, raw_status=#{rawStatus}, status=#{status}, paid_at=#{paidAt}, provider_updated_at=#{providerUpdatedAt}, custom_params=#{customParams}, raw_payload_json=#{rawPayloadJson}, sync_start_date=#{syncStartDate}, sync_end_date=#{syncEndDate}, last_synced_at=#{lastSyncedAt}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE promotion_order SET commission_status='REVERSED', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND commission_amount IS NOT NULL

UPDATE promotion_order SET tracking_no=#{trackingNo}, promotion_link_id=#{promotionLinkId}, user_id=#{userId}, drama_id=#{dramaId}, attribution_status=#{attributionStatus}, rule_history_id=#{ruleHistoryId}, channel_fee_rate=#{channelFeeRate}, principal_fee_rate=#{principalFeeRate}, principal_commission_rate=#{principalCommissionRate}, downstream_fee_rate=#{downstreamFeeRate}, downstream_commission_rate=#{downstreamCommissionRate}, commission_amount=#{commissionAmount}, commission_status=#{commissionStatus}, last_error_message=#{lastErrorMessage}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND rule_history_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotion_order ORDER BY paid_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='PAID' THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gross_order_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN commission_status='CALCULATED' THEN commission_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS calculated_commission, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN commission_status='REVERSED' THEN commission_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversed_commission FROM promotion_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND attribution_status='ATTRIBUTED' AND paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < #{endDate}
